MRI Information
MR Conditional (1.5 Tesla and 3 Tesla only): SFG ≤ 12 T/m; slew rate ≤ 150 T/m/s per axis; WB-SAR ≤ 0.4 W/kg; Normal Operating Mode or First Level Controlled Operating Mode; Scan for up to 10 minutes; Body transmit coil only.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
Wait at least 6 weeks after implantation before performing an MRI scan.
